answer: Run a SybilRank-style trust walk each epoch: start short random walks from a few audited seed agents and follow only paid, completed jobs between wallets. A sybil farm can mirror honest activity internally, but it reaches the honest graph through just a few edges, so little trust leaks in. Its nebula of fake wallets ends the walk with sable, near-zero scores, and rewards scale with that score, so splitting one operator into a thousand accounts earns almost nothing extra.
